items.exampleEn: For her, a quiet walk in the forest is a spiritual experience.
items.exampleZh: 對她來說，在森林裡安靜散步是一種心靈上的體驗。

items.exampleEn: He finds it hard to show his emotions.
items.exampleZh: 他很難表達自己的情緒。

items.exampleEn: The old lady was unable to carry her heavy bags.
items.exampleZh: 那位老太太提不動她重重的袋子。

items.exampleEn: There was some tension between the two teams.
items.exampleZh: 兩個團隊之間關係有點緊張。

items.exampleEn: I had a sudden urge to eat chocolate.
She speaks about art with great passion.
items.exampleZh: 她談起藝術時充滿熱情。

items.exampleEn: The view from the top of the tower was amazing.
items.exampleZh: 從塔頂看出去的景色太棒了。

items.exampleEn: Her story inspired me to start running.
items.exampleZh: 她的故事激勵我開始跑步。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher's passion for science inspired her students.
items.sentenceZh: 老師對科學的熱情激勵了她的學生。

items.audioEn: I'm sorry, but I'm unable to come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我明天早上無法參加會議。
items.questionZh: 說話者明天早上會怎樣？
options: Will be late for the meeting.
Needs a ride to the meeting.

items.sentenceEn: You could feel the tension in the room before the results came out.
items.sentenceZh: 結果出來之前，你可以感覺到房間裡的緊張氣氛。

items.sentenceEn: Try not to let your emotions control your decisions.
items.sentenceZh: 試著別讓情緒左右你的決定。

items.stemEn: The fireworks were ____; everyone was taking photos.
items.stemZh: 煙火棒極了，大家都在拍照。

items.stemEn: Writing is her ____; she writes every single day.
items.stemZh: 寫作是她最熱愛的事，她每天都在寫。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, Mr. Hsu was a bank manager. He was good at his job, but he felt no passion for it. One day, a friend took him to a pottery class. The class inspired him. The quiet work felt almost spiritual, and he forgot all the tension of the office. Soon he had a strong urge to leave the bank. At first, his family was worried, and he was unable to sleep for days. But he took the risk. Today his pottery shop is amazing, and every cup he makes shows a little emotion.
items.passageZh: 十年前，許先生是一位銀行經理。他工作能力很好，卻對工作沒有熱情。有一天，朋友帶他去上陶藝課。這堂課啟發了他。安靜的手作幾乎像一種心靈體驗，讓他忘了辦公室裡所有的緊張。很快地，他有一股想離開銀行的強烈衝動。一開始家人很擔心，他也好幾天睡不著。但他還是冒了這個險。現在他的陶藝店非常棒，他做的每個杯子都帶著一點情感。

questions.questionZh: 許先生以前是做什麼的？
陶藝課帶給許先生什麼感覺？
options: 很平靜，幾乎像心靈體驗

items.promptZh: 我昨天因為下雨無法出門。
referenceEn: I was unable to go out yesterday because of the rain.
Because it was raining yesterday, I was unable to leave home.
rubricZh: be unable to＋原形動詞，表示「無法⋯」
過去的事用過去式（例如 was unable to、couldn't）
寫 couldn't go out 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 inspire 造一個句子，說說一個激勵你的人或一件事。
referenceEn: My grandmother inspires me to work hard.
A trip to Japan inspired me to learn Japanese.
rubricZh: inspire 表示「激勵、啟發」，可只接人（例如 inspires me），也可再加 to＋原形動詞
時態配合內容（例如 inspires、inspired）
